name: Chart
description: A bar, line, area or donut chart drawn in plain SVG without a chart library. It fits its container, can be explored with a pointer or the arrow keys, and always comes with a written summary and a View as table switch that shows the same numbers.

data.description: The labels along the bottom and one or more named series of values. A donut draws the first series only.

summary.description: A sentence that tells the story of the chart. Defaults to a sentence written from the data.

type.description: Bars, a line, a filled area or a donut.

stacked.description: Add the series up instead of drawing them side by side. Applies to bar and area.

height.description: Height of the drawing in pixels. The width follows the container.

showLegend.description: Name each series (or each donut slice) below the drawing. Hidden for a single series except in a donut.

showGrid.description: Draw grid lines behind bar, line and area charts.

valueFormat.description: Turns a value into text for the axis, the tooltip, the labels and the table. Defaults to compact numbers with the data unit.

onSelect.description: Called when a point is clicked, or when Enter or Space is pressed on the active point.
onSelect.tsType: (point: { index: number; label: string; series: string; value: number }) => void

isLoading.description: Show a placeholder the size of the chart instead of the drawing.

emptyMessage.description: Shown when there is nothing to chart.

keyboard: Tab: moves to the plot, which is one tab stop
ArrowLeft / ArrowRight: move to the previous or next value (ArrowUp / ArrowDown on a donut)
Home / End: jump to the first or last value
Enter / Space: selects the active value (calls onSelect)
requirements: The drawing is decoration; the title, the written summary and the data table carry the meaning
The plot is a single focusable group named by the title, described by the summary, with a visible focus ring
Moving with the keyboard announces the active value as text, for example "Feb: Revenue $26,500, Cost $12,000"
View as table swaps in the same data as an accessible table (aria-pressed on the switch)
Series differ by marker shape or label as well as color; the legend repeats the same marks
A donut names each slice with its percentage; slices are separated by a gap
Colors come only from the chart color tokens and text stays at 4.5:1
Loading is marked with aria-busy and shows no invented numbers
Empty data shows a message instead of an empty frame
screenReader: Announced as a figure named by the title, then the summary text
"Revenue by month. Use the left and right arrow keys to move between values, group"
Each arrow key press reads the active value, such as "Feb: Revenue $26,500, Cost $12,000"
"View as table, toggle button, not pressed"
The table reads every value under its row and column headers

use_when: Showing trends, comparisons or shares of a whole in a product screen
Letting people point at a value to read it exactly
avoid_when: Dashboards with many linked, zoomable charts: use a charting library
Exact numbers matter most: show a table
A single number with a trend: use Stat with a Sparkline
anti_patterns: Telling series apart by color only
A donut with many slices or with several series (it draws the first series only)
Hard-coding series colors instead of the chart color tokens
